reconstructed_theorem_text: Let E be a finite-dimensional real normed inner-product space of dimension n+1, where n is any natural number, and let A:E→E be a continuous real linear symmetric operator. Give the unit sphere S={x∈E:‖x‖=1} its n-dimensional sphere manifold structure. Define f:S→ℝ by f(y)=⟨y,Ay⟩ and let i:S→E be the inclusion. Write Df(x) and Di(x) for the manifold derivatives used by the Lean statement, with those derivatives totalized to zero outside differentiability. For every x∈S and every z∈(ℝx)⊥, the identity Df(x)[w]=⟨Di(x)[w],z⟩ for every abstract tangent vector w∈T_x S holds if and only if, as an equality of vectors in E, z=2(Ax−⟨x,Ax⟩x).
